faq.title: Everything You Need to Know
faq.subtitle: Still have a trading question? Reach our customer service team for support.

items.a: A Contract for Difference (CFD) lets you speculate on the price movement of an asset without owning it. You can go long if you expect the price to rise or short if you expect it to fall.

items.q: Which markets can I trade with GTCFX?
items.a: You can trade CFDs on forex, metals, energy, indices, commodities, shares, crypto and futures — all from one account.
Leverage lets you control a larger position with a smaller amount of capital. It magnifies both profits and losses, so it should be used with care.

items.q: How do spreads and commissions work?
items.a: The spread is the difference between the bid and ask price. Standard accounts are commission-free with spreads from 1.0 pips, while ECN accounts offer spreads from 0.0 pips with a $5 per lot commission.

items.q: What is margin and how is it calculated?
items.a: Margin is the amount required to open and maintain a leveraged position. It is calculated from the trade size, the instrument price and the leverage applied to your account.

risk: Trading in derivatives, including rolling spot Foreign Exchange (FX) and Contracts for Difference (CFDs), is highly speculative, carries a substantial degree of risk, and is not appropriate for every investor. FX and CFDs are complex instruments dealt on a margined basis and carry a high risk of losing money rapidly by reason of leverage, which magnifies gains and losses alike. You may lose part or all of your invested capital, and losses may exceed your initial investment. Before trading, you should consider your objectives, financial position, level of experience and appetite for risk, satisfy yourself that you understand how these products operate, and trade only with funds you can afford to lose.
